findings.title: Recovery codes remain reusable in the user-storage test provider
findings.body: This validator only checks whether the submitted code appears in the stored list; it never removes the matched code or persists an updated list. Since authentication delegates validation to this user-storage provider, a successfully used recovery code remains valid for subsequent logins. The new integration test exercises only one login, so it does not catch the violation of recovery codes' one-time-use behavior.
